guidelines: Anything inside brackets [ ] is an example and should be replaced with real answers or be deleted.
The symbol > signifies comments to the user, and should be deleted after the README is filled.
The symbols - - - signify separation of sections and do not need to be deleted.
The README file name starts with an underscore _ in order to make it appear first in the list of files, when sorted alphabetically.

For simple text format use this [file](https://github.com/Czech-Data-Steward-Community/README_FILES_EXAMPLES/blob/main/_README-TXT.txt) and for markdown template use this [file](https://github.com/Czech-Data-Steward-Community/README_FILES_EXAMPLES/blob/main/_README-MD.md)
After filling in the README you can delete the first page with instructions or remove this guidelines array from your JSON data.

brief_description.label: Brief Description
brief_description.instruction: Write 2–3 sentences describing what the dataset contains and what it is used for.

research_context.label: Research Context
research_context.instruction: Write a brief description of the research project in which the data were produced. What were the goals? What questions was the research intended to answer?

related_publications.label: Related Publications
related_publications.instruction: List of publications (articles and data) where the data were used or presented, or if they are relevant to understanding the dataset.

directory_structure.label: Directory Structure
directory_structure.instruction: Describe the directory structure. If the structure is complex, you may describe it in text and/or visually using a directory tree, like the one below.

file_descriptions.label: File Descriptions
file_descriptions.instruction: List the data files showing what each file contains. For large datasets, refer to an accompanying file description. If the content is evident from the file name, describe only the directory structure. Don't forget to explain any file names that are not clear.

naming_conventions.label: Naming Conventions
naming_conventions.instruction: Explain any abbreviations used in the file name or inside the data file itself.

encoding.label: Encoding
encoding.instruction: Fill in according to the nature of the data.

variable_descriptions.label: Variable Descriptions
variable_descriptions.instruction: List the variables of the data. Include the variable name, data type, unit (if relevant), a brief description, and examples or value ranges where applicable.

special_values.label: Special Values
special_values.instruction: Explain how special values are represented in the data, such as missing data, unknown values, infinity, etc. Specify which concrete values or codes are used for these purposes.

collection/creation_of_data.label: Collection/Creation of Data
collection/creation_of_data.instruction: Describe the method of data collection/creation

processing.label: Processing
processing.instruction: If the data were produced by transforming other data, describe the original data and the transformation applied. Describe the data processing steps: cleaning, transformation, anonymisation, formatting etc.

method_of_data_processing.label: Method of Data Processing
method_of_data_processing.instruction: Add the software names (with version) used for the data processing. You can also simply describe the processing workflow, if no software was used.

data_completeness.label: Data Completeness
data_completeness.instruction: Describe data quality, known limitations, missing values, etc. How was the quality tested? Did you perform an integrity check?

license_and_terms_of_use.label: License and Terms of Use
license_and_terms_of_use.instruction: Include the license text or link where it can be found, any copyright notice and any specific conditions for use of the data, for example if individual files are licensed differently.

restrictions_and_recommendations.label: Restrictions and Recommendations
restrictions_and_recommendations.instruction: State any additional restrictions or recommendations for use.

software_and_hardware_requirements.label: Software and Hardware Requirements
software_and_hardware_requirements.instruction: Fill in only if the data contain personal data or sensitive information. If the data contain no personal data, delete this section.

personal_and_sensitive_data_protection.label: Personal and Sensitive Data Protection
personal_and_sensitive_data_protection.instruction: Describe how the protection of personal/sensitive data was ensured, if the data contains sensitive information.

ethical_approval.label: Ethical Approval
ethical_approval.instruction: If ethical approval was required, state:

informed_consent.label: Informed Consent
informed_consent.instruction: You may thank collaborators, research participants, funding providers, etc.
